cross_references.description: Title II rights are enforceable through §1983 — individuals can sue state and local officials directly for disability discrimination under color of law.
Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973. The first federal disability rights law. Only covered federally funded programs. §12132 extended the same principle to all public entities.
Definitions for Title II of the ADA. Defines 'public entity' and 'qualified individual with a disability' — the two key terms in §12132.
